tagline.en_US: Cops by Sébastien Lucas, now maintained by MikesPub, stands for Calibre OPDS (and HTML) Php Server.

description.en_US: Cops (Calibre OPDS and HTML Php Server) is a lightweight alternative to Calibre's content server. It connects to an existing Calibre library database and provides an HTML web interface alongside an OPDS feed for mobile devices and e-readers. Users can search, view, download, and email e-books with minimal CPU and memory overhead. Any updates made to the underlying Calibre library are reflected immediately.
